posts.cooked:
So Dark Psuedonym over on the Kickstarter just gave me a truly terrifying thought that I'd like to share with everyone.

 

What if instead of Voss Tim Cosing is Spite/Jack Donovan?

 

In terms of "worst person to get cosmic power" Spite trumps that list by miles, and, it is interesting that we haven't had an episode of the Letters page for Spite. Maybe he's too niche to get his own page, because all of his story is told by Gloomweaver and Wraith, but also it is possible that they are saving his episode so that they don't spoil him being a Scion.

 

And the message from the Scion of "Trust me, I'm a much better choice than Oblivaeon to have all that power" takes a much darker tone if it is coming from a psycho serial killer instead of from a warlord. Spite wouldn't want to destroy reality, he'd want to play with it. And isn't that just enought to make you shudder.

 

The only reason I could think of that ol' Smiling Jack couldn't be a Scion is because Gloomweaver "ate" him to make Skinwalker, and there might not be enough of him left to be turned into a Scion.

 

Still, it was a fascinating idea that was scary enough I wanted to share it.
